failure_summary.description: For a bare list of people, the agent returned a generic shared role instead of the more specific shared relation supported by context.

patch.reasoning: The skill covers lists of character names but not lists of people whose shared jurisdiction or affiliation is the implied target. Add guidance to prefer a distinctive, context-supported shared relation over a generic common category.

edits.content: When a prompt consists only of a list of people, use context to infer the distinctive relation connecting them if one is clearly supported. Prefer a specific shared attribute, such as a jurisdiction or affiliation, over a generic shared role; do not guess if several relations are equally plausible.
